reproduction.record_sha256_method: SHA-256 of compact sorted JSON encoded as UTF-8 with ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True and separators=(',', ':'), without a trailing LF. This is not the compiler record pin, whose serialized input includes a trailing LF.
reproduction.input_acquisition: git show <baseline_commit>:<POSIX repository path>; hash original bytes; decode strict UTF-8. No working-tree data substitution.
reproduction.labels: All name/source_designation/designation/names values/aliases[].text in every identity, grade and state. Occurrences are not identity counts.
reproduction.comparison: strip/casefold exact; NFKC/casefold/collapsed-whitespace exact; ASCII-alphanumeric exact; separate bounded-token matches. These comparisons are not a chemical-equivalence engine.
